mechanism.claim: A volatile completed BTC spot move that spends little uninterrupted time away from its running favorable close extreme is repeatedly discovering new cash prices rather than relying on one terminal impulse; when the full spot block and final two hours agree, follow that cash direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed spot eight-hour and final-two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVAUD is perpetual-only. HVSAUD independently computes running-extreme underwater duration on actual spot closes and uses perpetual variation solely as the requested volatile-regime gate. It uses no HVAUD event set, volume, flow, OI, funding, premium, options, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: spot path-duration onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.spot_block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance_spot BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h), same strict sign as block return
features.directional_underwater: for positive side close strictly below running maximum close; for negative side close strictly above running minimum close
features.adverse_duration: longest consecutive directional-underwater run divided by 480
features.duration_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 spot-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank<=0.25
features.variation_gate: frozen causal perpetual variation_rank>=0.65 at same decision
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact jointly valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: source, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no venue, duration formula, history, rank, variation, return confirmation, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
